description: Fix staff appointment letter generation. Replace API route fetch with direct Supabase client queries to avoid HTTP 406 errors. Handle WebSocket disconnection gracefully. Include staff role/position in letter body (currently shows only 'Staff'). Verify LetterPreviewModal buttons (Preview, Download, Share, Edit) work correctly.
steps: In src/services/letter-generation.service.ts, locate the fetchStaffData method (around line 40). Replace the fetch() call to API route with direct Supabase queries: query staff table for id, user_id, position, department, employment_date, salary, bank_name, account_number, account_name. Then query users table for id, full_name, email, phone, gender, role. Use .maybeSingle() instead of .single().
In fetchStaffData return object, ensure role field is populated from userData.role (not hardcoded 'Staff Member'). Also populate position field from staffRecord.position.

In the generateAppointmentLetter method (around line 220), find the letter body text. Change 'offer you a position of [Position] as a staff member' to 'offer you a position of [Position] as a [Role]'. Update the details table to include Role row showing staffData.role.

In LetterPreviewModal (src/components/admin/LetterPreviewModal.tsx), verify that the modal has buttons for: Preview (show HTML in iframe), Download (generate PDF), Share (email/WhatsApp), Edit (text editor). These should already exist; verify they call correct functions and don't error.
Test end-to-end: Open LetterPreviewModal with letterType='appointment', verify staffData loads correctly with role field, verify letter HTML shows role, verify buttons work.
acceptance_criteria: LetterPreviewModal opens without errors when 'Generate Appointment Letter' clicked
Staff data loads from Supabase (no 406 errors)
Letter HTML displays staff role (e.g., 'Teacher', 'Principal') not just 'Staff'
Download button generates PDF with correct content
verification: Click 'Generate Appointment Letter' on any staff member
Verify modal opens with letter preview
Click Share, verify email/WhatsApp dialog appears
Click Edit, verify text is editable
Check browser console for no errors or warnings
